roleBonus.engineer: Repairs take 1 day when on Maintenance
roleBonus.scientist: +15% science points on Research or EVA

taskHelp.maintenance: Needed for fast repairs and panel cleaning.
taskHelp.greenhouse: Tends the plants. The Botanist adds +10% food.
taskHelp.research: Runs lab experiments for science points.
taskHelp.regolith: Processes surface soil into +3 build points a day.
taskHelp.eva: Spacewalk for samples. Needs exactly 2 crew.

outcomeExplain.o2: The oxygen tanks emptied and the generator could not keep up with the crew's breathing.
outcomeExplain.water: The water tanks ran dry. Without enough recycling, water is lost every day.
outcomeExplain.food: The crew ate less than half of what they needed for 3 days in a row.
outcomeExplain.evacuated: Three or more astronauts became too unwell and had to be sent home.

headlines.normal: A calm day. All systems received full power.
headlines.allServedWaste: All systems ran, but {kwh} kWh of sunshine was wasted.
headlines.shedNight: The battery ran out during the night and {systems} lost power.
headlines.shedEvent: {event} cut solar power by {pct}%, and {systems} lost power.
headlines.shedGeneric: Power ran {kwh} kWh short, and {systems} lost power.
headlines.eventHandled: {event} continues, but every system kept full power.
headlines.missionComplete: {label} {day} complete. The mission is a success!
headlines.spe: A solar storm hit the base. Average dose today: {dose} mSv.
headlines.speSheltered: A solar storm hit, but the shelter blocked most of it. Average dose today: {dose} mSv.
headlines.resupply: The resupply lander arrived: +{food} kcal of food and +{bp} build points.
headlines.evacuation: {name} became too unwell and was evacuated.

chain.smallBattery: Battery too small for the night

chainDetail.dustStorm: Dust in the air blocks sunlight before it reaches the panels.
chainDetail.shadow: The crater rim is blocking the Sun, so the panels are in shadow.
chainDetail.panelDust: Dust settled on the panels and blocks part of the light.
chainDetail.solarDrop: Less sunlight on the panels means less electricity.
chainDetail.smallBattery: Half of every sol is night. The battery could not store enough to last until sunrise.
chainDetail.batteryFull: Once the battery is full, extra solar energy has nowhere to go. A bigger battery would store it for the night.
chainDetail.deficit: The base needed more energy than the panels and battery could give.
chainDetail.shed: When power is short, systems at the bottom of the priority list are switched off first.
chainDetail.spe: The Sun threw out a burst of fast protons. They pass through thin walls.
chainDetail.shelter: Water tanks around the shelter absorb most of the protons.
chainDetail.waterDelayed: Without power, used water waits in a tank. It is cleaned later, but the tank can overflow.
chainDetail.dose: Radiation dose adds up over the whole mission.
chainDetail.failure: Machines wear out. Spare parts and a good engineer keep the base running.
chainDetail.cropDisease: A disease spreads quickly when all plants are the same type.
chainDetail.resupply: Cargo from Earth takes months to arrive, so it is planned far ahead.

botanist.shed: My plants need light soon, or this harvest is lost!
botanist.disease: I'm removing the sick plants before the disease spreads.
botanist.harvest: First full harvest! Fresh salad for everyone tonight.
botanist.normal: The plants look green and healthy today.

engineer.deficit: We're short on power. I can't keep every system running tonight.
engineer.failure: I've found the fault. Give me time and parts and I'll fix it.
engineer.dust: These panels are covered in dust. A cleaning would help a lot.
engineer.normal: All systems nominal. The power bus is stable.

medic.dose: Radiation doses are rising. We should strengthen our shielding.
medic.health: Some of the crew are not well. They need food, water and rest.
medic.sick: I'm looking after our patient. Rest is the best medicine.
medic.normal: Everyone passed their health check this morning.

scientist.eva: Look at these rock layers! This sample could tell us about ancient water.
scientist.lab: The lab results are coming in nicely.
scientist.normal: Every day here teaches us something new.

commander.storm: Stay calm and follow the plan. We've trained for this.
commander.spe: Everyone into the shelter, now. No exceptions.
commander.normal: Good work, team. One more day closer to home.

tutorial.title: This is your oxygen
tutorial.text: Your crew breathes 0.82 kg each per day. The gauge shows how many days it will last.

tutorial.title: Power comes from the Sun
tutorial.text: Solar panels make electricity. Dust and darkness reduce it, and the battery covers the night.

tutorial.title: You decide who gets power
tutorial.text: Drag systems to change their priority, or move the greenhouse slider to give it more or less light.

tutorial.title: End the day
tutorial.text: When you are ready, press End Sol. The simulation runs one day with your decisions.

tutorial.title: Learn what happened
tutorial.text: Read the report. The "Why did this happen?" button explains every change, step by step.

demoGuide.1: Day 1: Look at the battery. It will run short at night. Open Build and upgrade the Battery Bank, then press End Sol.
demoGuide.2: Day 2: A dust storm is forecast for tomorrow. Lower the greenhouse and lab sliders to save energy, then End Sol.
demoGuide.3: Day 3: The storm is here. Read the report and open "Why did this happen?" to see the chain of causes.
demoGuide.4: Day 4: The storm continues. Keep life support and heating at the top of the priority list.
demoGuide.5: Day 5: The storm is clearing. Panels are dusty — try Clean panels with a crew member on Maintenance.
demoGuide.6: Day 6: A solar flare is forecast. If you built a Storm Shelter, use Shelter. Otherwise, note the radiation lesson.
demoGuide.7: Day 7: Last day of the demo. Press End Sol to see your mission debrief.
